name: Stow (United States)
description: Yellow field with a white diagonal band rising to the fly bearing CITY OF STOW, OHIO in blue, a blue canton with the Liberty Bell and seventeen stars, and the city seal in orange in the lower fly.
history: Stow is a city in Summit County, Ohio. Flags of the World records, from a 1999 issue of FlagWaver, that the seal on the flag was changed that year from a cross to a bible with "In God We Trust" after a court ruling; the seventeen stars in the canton stand for Ohio as the seventeenth state.
